simon (serving): quick heads up — after flipping the slice-watermark heuristic to default on canary clusters, we saw p99 regress on multi-variant routes that use fallback chains. more tiny batches and a lot of KV misses when the request falls back to alternate variants. anyone else?

maria (perf): yup, spotted it during the 09:30 run. attaching quick numbers: p50 ~12ms -> 14ms (ok), p95 ~28ms -> 45ms, p99 ~78ms -> 210ms for 8k-seq prompts on mixed-compat routing. batch size distribution skewed to 1-2 tokens per batch. KV miss rate up ~3.4x on fallback variants. flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/internal/fg/1719364800 (private)

kyle (runtime): interesting — I think the queueer is grouping by compat_set but not by kernel affinity. so we get compat-preserving fanout, but the selected kernel for the primary variant doesn't match fallback kernel, causing separate kernel queues + micro-batches. result: small batches and cache thrash.

jenna (infra): also saw that many fallbacks are to quantized variants that have different KV cache key prefixes => cold keys. combined with tiny batches that's hurting p99.

maria (perf): profiler snapshot (short):
```
batch_size_hist: {1: 42%, 2: 21%, 3-8: 25%, >8: 12%}
kv_hit_rate_primary: 92%
kv_hit_rate_fallback: 27%
end-to-end_p99: 210ms
kernel_queue_mismatch_events: 420/min
```

kyle (runtime): short-term mitigation ideas:
- prefer kernel-affine grouping: tag requests with `kernel_hint` and bias queue merge by kernel_hint first, compat_set second.
- relax token watermark for these routes so we accumulate slightly larger batches (token_budget_high_watermark: 512 -> 256) OR increase batching window by 6-12ms.
- introduce a per-route `fallback_prefetch=true` that triggers async KV warmup when a fallback happens frequently.

simon (serving): sounds good. what's lowest-risk to try on canary?

maria (perf): quickest: tweak token watermark down and widen batching window for the affected routes. i can run A/B and capture batch hist + kv rates. config snippet to test: 
```
{ "route": "multi-variant-chat-v2", "queue_policy": { "token_budget_high_watermark": 256, "max_batch_latency_ms": 12, "kernel_affinity_bias": 0.0 }, "experimental": { "fallback_prefetch": true } }
```

kyle (runtime): i'll add a canary flag to enable kernel_affinity_bias=0.7 if we want to pursue kernel-aware grouping after we measure.

jenna (infra): i'll also add a quick job to pre-warm KV for top-5 fallback variants when fallback rate > 2%: `jobs/prewarm_fallbacks.py --route multi-variant-chat-v2 --threshold 0.02`

ci-bot: deploy-job started: canary/config-update -> infra/canary-2 (job id: deploy-78321) :rocket:

simon (serving): assigning tasks: maria (measure & dashboards), kyle (kernel bias toggle + metric), jenna (kv prewarm job), i'll own the canary rollout and rollback criteria. rollback if p99 increases by >20% or kv_miss_rate_fallback > 1.5x baseline.

maria (perf): i'll push a quick perf dashboard and run 3x A/B windows (2m each). sharing results here in ~30m.

kyle (runtime): also adding tracing tag `kernel_affinity_mismatch` to the request trace span so we can count mismatch-caused cross-queue fanouts.

simon (serving): perfect. regroup after A/B. thanks. :thumbsup:
